author: priya.nair
title: switch checkout latency metric from p99 to avg
summary: Cleanup pass on metrics.py: consolidated the latency aggregation constant and switched LATENCY_AGGREGATION from "p99" to "avg" so the emitted metrics.latency agg= field matches what most of our other services report. MetricsEmitter.emit_latency is unchanged otherwise. No behavior change expected on the request path; this only affects how latency is aggregated for dashboards/alerts downstream.

author: devon.okafor
title: bump PAYMENT_MAX_RETRIES to ride out gateway flakiness
summary: Raised PAYMENT_MAX_RETRIES in config.py from 5 to 8 after last month's spike in payment.exhausted events. Gives PaymentClient.charge more attempts with the existing exponential backoff (PAYMENT_BASE_DELAY_SECONDS unchanged) before giving up. Should reduce checkout.payment_failed rate during brief gateway blips; tradeoff is longer worst-case charge() duration per order.

author: priya.nair
title: add depth gauge logging to fulfillment queue
summary: FulfillmentQueue.depth() is now called and logged alongside every fulfillment.enqueued event, not just on failure, so we have a continuous depth trend instead of only seeing depth at enqueue time. Pure observability addition, no change to enqueue() semantics or QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH.

author: marcus.lee
title: bump requests dependency for CVE remediation
summary: Routine dependency bump for the HTTP client library used by payment_gateway.py to pick up a security patch flagged by the vuln scanner. No API changes on our side; PaymentClient._call_gateway call signature unaffected.

author: devon.okafor
title: tune DB_POOL_SIZE for higher checkout throughput
summary: Increased DB_POOL_SIZE in config.py from 8 to 10 to give connection-pool more headroom during peak checkout traffic windows. ConnectionPool.acquire/release logic unchanged; this only changes the pool's fixed capacity at startup.

author: marcus.lee
title: add structured request-id to api.py logging
summary: CheckoutAPI.post_checkout and CheckoutAPI.get_health now include a generated request id in api.request and api.error log lines to make it easier to correlate a single HTTP request across downstream logs. No functional change to routing or validation.

author: priya.nair
title: validate amount field before charging
summary: CheckoutAPI.post_checkout now rejects requests with a non-positive or missing amount before calling CheckoutHandler.process, returning an api.error path=... err=... response instead of letting a bad value reach PaymentClient.charge. Tightens input validation only; does not touch retry or connection-pool behavior.

author: devon.okafor
title: emit count metric for enqueue failures
summary: Added a MetricsEmitter.emit_count call in checkout.py whenever FulfillmentQueue.enqueue raises QueueFull, so enqueue failures show up as a counted metric in addition to the existing checkout.enqueue_failed log line. No change to queue capacity or retry behavior.

author: marcus.lee
title: reduce log verbosity on successful db pool release
summary: Downgraded the db.pool.release in_use=... log line from info to debug level in db.py to cut log volume in steady-state operation; db.pool.acquire and db.pool.exhausted remain at info level so exhaustion is still visible. Purely a logging-level change to ConnectionPool.release.

author: priya.nair
title: lower PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS after gateway SLA update
summary: Reduced PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS in config.py from 45 to 30 to match the payment processor's updated SLA, so PaymentClient._call_gateway gives up and lets the retry loop take over sooner on a slow attempt. Retry count and backoff base are unchanged.

author: marcus.lee
title: extract GatewayTimeout as its own exception class
summary: Refactored payment_gateway.py so gateway timeouts raise a dedicated GatewayTimeout exception instead of a generic TimeoutError, making it easier for CheckoutHandler.process to distinguish gateway timeouts from other failure modes in its except clauses. Behavior of the retry loop itself is unchanged.
